trigger_evals.prompt: Humanize this paragraph so it stops sounding AI-generated but keep every fact exactly as written.
Rewrite this article in a more natural human voice without adding any facts.
Can you de-AI this text? It has too many em dashes, fake significance claims, and generic conclusions.
Make this generated documentation sound like a developer wrote it, but keep the technical meaning unchanged.
Review this essay for obvious AI-writing tells and rewrite the affected passages.
Use my writing sample to rewrite this draft so it sounds like me rather than ChatGPT.
Remove the promotional AI tone from this destination description without deleting sourced details.
Polish this report specifically to remove LLM-style filler, rule-of-three phrasing, and vague attributions.
Humanize the prose in this Markdown file in place. Leave code blocks and frontmatter untouched.
This PR description reads like AI slop. Rewrite it naturally and preserve all implementation facts.
Naturalize this biography without guessing anything about the person's private life.
Make this text less robotic while preserving my punctuation and sentence rhythm from the sample below.
Summarize this article in five bullets.
Proofread this paragraph for spelling mistakes only.
Translate this report from English to Portuguese.
Write a new blog post about PostgreSQL indexes from scratch.
Explain whether em dashes are grammatically correct in English.
Detect whether this text was definitely written by AI and give me a probability score.
Shorten this paragraph to 100 words without changing its style.
Convert this README into JSON.
Fix the TypeScript errors in this Vue component.
Create a GitHub issue from these requirements.
Give me feedback on the argument in this essay, but do not rewrite it.
Format these release notes according to Keep a Changelog.

output_evals.prompt: Humanize this text without adding facts: 'The project began in 2021. It has 14 contributors. Observers have cited its pivotal role in shaping the evolving landscape of local tooling.'
assertions: Preserves the year 2021 and the number 14 exactly.
Does not invent names, sources, dates, causes, locations, or measurements.
Removes or neutralizes the vague attribution and inflated significance language rather than making the attribution more specific without evidence.
Runs the draft, audit, final loop because the input is pasted text.
The final rewrite contains no em dash or en dash unless an author sample establishes that style.

output_evals.prompt: Humanize the draft using this author sample as the voice target. The sample repeatedly uses em dashes, fragments, and parenthetical self-corrections. Preserve that voice while removing promotional AI wording from the draft.
assertions: Analyzes the supplied sample before rewriting.
Treats the sample as higher priority than the default em-dash ban.
Preserves characteristic fragments, parentheticals, rhythm, and vocabulary when they do not change meaning.
Removes promotional and formulaic AI patterns without regularizing the author into generic polished prose.
Does not add factual detail to manufacture personality.

output_evals.prompt: Humanize README.md in place. The file contains YAML frontmatter, prose, fenced shell commands, JSON examples, and Markdown links.
assertions: Uses file mode and runs the draft and audit internally.
Rewrites only editable prose.
Preserves frontmatter, fenced code, structured data, and link targets.
Writes only the final rewrite back to the file.
Returns a short summary instead of pasting the full rewritten file into conversation.

output_evals.prompt: Review this polished technical paragraph for AI-like writing and humanize only where justified. It contains one em dash, one semicolon, formal vocabulary, and otherwise specific implementation details.
assertions: Does not treat perfect grammar, formal vocabulary, one em dash, or one semicolon as proof of AI authorship.
Looks for clusters of the documented 33 patterns before making broad changes.
Preserves unusual and specific implementation details.
Keeps technical register and precision rather than forcing casual prose.
Does not claim certainty about whether a human or model authored the source.

output_evals.prompt: Humanize this biography: 'Information about her early life is not publicly available, suggesting she maintains a low profile. She likely grew up in a middle-class household, which shaped her later interest in education reform.' No other source material is available.
assertions: Removes the unsupported inference that privacy implies a low profile.
Removes the guessed middle-class background and causal explanation.
Does not replace the guesses with different plausible biographical filler.
Either states plainly that the early life is not documented in the available source or omits the unsupported section.
The final text contains no fabricated specificity.

output_evals.prompt: An upstream PR-writing workflow passes a completed PR description through humanize-text as its final editing step.
assertions: Uses embedded mode.
Runs the pattern scan and two-question audit internally.
Returns only the final rewritten PR description.
Does not emit draft labels, audit bullets, generic praise, or offers to continue.
Preserves all implementation facts, issue references, citations, and link targets.
